landing.title: The page stays. The language changes.
landing.body: Drop a scanned contract, letter, or form. DocTranslate reads it, translates it, and gives you a PDF with the same page size and the same text positions.

steps.title: Upload
steps.body: PDF, JPG, PNG, or WEBP goes straight to private storage.

steps.title: Translate
steps.body: Each page is read, grouped into paragraphs, and translated.

steps.title: Export
steps.body: Download a laid-out PDF or the translated blocks as JSON.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.body: Magic link or Google. Anonymous use is not available.
auth.sent: Check your inbox for the sign-in link.
auth.devHint: Local demo mode is on. No Supabase project is required.

dashboard.title: New translation
dashboard.drop: Drop a scan here, or browse
dashboard.hint: PDF, JPG, PNG, WEBP · 15 MB · 20 pages
dashboard.waking: The server is waking up. This can take up to a minute.

settings.title: Settings
settings.retention: Files and extracted text are deleted after the retention window (24 hours by default). Integrity hashes stay in an append-only log and do not include document text.

verify.title: Verify a file
verify.body: Upload a file to check whether its SHA-256 matches a translation recorded for your account.
verify.match: This file matches a stored record.
verify.miss: No stored record matches this file.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.boundary: This screen hit an unexpected error.
